name: FNIRSI GC-01 Geiger Counter
summary: A portable Geiger-counter reference for certain ionising radiation. It cannot certify food, water or an area as safe; Canadian listing identity and conflicting range specifications remain unresolved.
description: A radiation meter is useful only when its response and limitations are understood. This profile covers the GC-01 model documented by FNIRSI, not a calibrated survey instrument or an emergency clearance service. Its readings cannot identify every radionuclide or establish contamination levels in food. Keep public emergency instructions at the centre of a preparedness plan; never enter a suspect area to obtain a measurement.

pros: Portable format for learning about instrument readings within a supervised, non-hazardous setting.
Separate rate and accumulated-dose displays are described in the model documentation.
cons: No traceable calibration or delivered-unit accuracy has been established.
The manufacturer page contains incompatible maximum dose-rate values.
The exact Canadian ASIN/model match has not been established; the buying button remains unavailable.
useCases: Study radiation terminology and the distinction between counts, dose rate and cumulative dose.
Discuss appropriate monitoring equipment with a radiation-protection professional before relying on a meter.

confirmed.text: FNIRSI documents a GC-01 using a GM tube and several alarm modes. This is a manufacturer description, not a calibration result.
Canadian emergency guidance prioritises sheltering and following official directions.

unverifiedClaims: Current Canadian ASIN/model selection, seller, package, lot and delivered-unit labels remain unverified.
safetyNotes: No universal alpha, neutron, radionuclide-identification or contamination-measurement capability is established.
Do not use this illustration, a low reading or a silent alarm to decide that food, water or a location is safe.
Follow emergency authorities and shelter or evacuation directions; no instrument guarantees safety in a nuclear emergency.
